label: GitHub CLI
about: Signs the gh command in with your GitHub account, using GitHub's device code: no address to copy back, wherever your browser is.
notes: --insecure-storage keeps the token in hosts.yml (0600) instead of an OS keychain, which a headless server does not have. GH_CONFIG_DIR puts that file in the company's connections folder; a crew tool that should use this sign-in runs gh with the same GH_CONFIG_DIR.
